items.label: la vision
items.scene: An eagle with perfect VISION ("vee-ZYOHN") reads the tiniest shapes on the chart from across the room.

items.label: la paupière
items.scene: A sleepy owl's EYELID droops shut as she sniffs a red POPPY ("poh-PYEHR") in a little pot.

items.label: l'illusion
items.scene: A spinning spiral card makes an optical ILLUSION ("ee-lew-ZYOHN"), and a patient's eyes go round and round.

items.label: la perspective
items.scene: A PEAR in SPECS ("pehr-SPEHK") gazes down a model street of lampposts shrinking into PERSPECTIVE.

items.label: la reconnaissance
items.scene: An old man who can see again RECOGNISES his optician at last ("ruh-koh-neh-SAHNS") and hugs her with a thank-you bouquet, full of GRATITUDE.

items.label: le sourcil
items.scene: A SAUCY ("soor-SEE") clown tries on frames and raises one bushy EYEBROW high above them.
